test_telegram_reconnect_self_schedules_o: test the TelegramAdapter reconnects and self-schedules a retry task when start_polling fails with a network error
test_telegram_reconnect_no_retry_when_fa: test the TelegramAdapter does not schedule a retry task when a fatal error is already set
test_telegram_reconnect_resets_error_cou: test the TelegramAdapter resets _polling_network_error_count to zero after successful reconnect
test_telegram_reconnect_triggers_fatal_a: test the TelegramAdapter sets a fatal error and calls the fatal handler after exceeding MAX_NETWORK_RETRIES
test_telegram_make_adapter_fixture: test the _make_adapter helper creates a TelegramAdapter instance from PlatformConfig with a test token
